hook.name: RobinhoodRWIV4LaunchHook
hook.description: Factory and hook for launching fixed-supply TOKEN/RWI pools on Robinhood Chain. Restricts pool initialization to the hook itself via beforeInitialize, and uses beforeSwap with a return delta to internally match accumulated token-fee inventory against organic RWI buys at the current pool price, routing that portion directly without going through the AMM curve.
